assets.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: original transparent top-down pixel-art combat sprite reference for a portrait H5 space survivor game, to be hand-cleaned on a native 64x64 pixel grid.
Primary request: a mechanical black-hole singularity weapon with a true empty transparent central hole, a thin dark-violet event-horizon rim, a bright gold-white circular accretion disc, and a separate outer ring made of six disconnected angular violet crystal-machine segments. Everything is centered at one pivot. Clear transparent gaps between core rim, accretion disc and segmented outer ring so they can be independently rotated. The outer ring has sharp chamfered armor plates, little brass clamps and violet crystal facets. The accretion disc has two asymmetric bright arcs suggesting directional swirl. This must be a substantial complex mechanical ring silhouette with a dark hollow eye, visibly unique from a four-prong gravity burst.
Style/medium: deliberately crisp native-pixel sprite art, medium pixel detail with readable clusters, about 64x64 logical pixels enlarged with integer nearest-neighbor scaling. Strict stepped pixel edges and hard color clusters. Top-down orthographic, no perspective.
Color palette: deep ink #17172b, purple-grey armor #393449 #57516d #756c8e, violet #7151a0 #a483c4 #d1b5e3, brass #825d42 #bd8a51, gold #f4c57a, cream #ffe5a6 and tiny white highlights.
Composition/framing: one complete circular weapon alone centered, no cropping, generous transparent outer margin, transparent empty circular hole at the very center. No text, no labels, no scene, no background, no glow haze, no soft shadows, no blur, no gradients, no smooth vector contours, no UI frame, no sparks outside the silhouette. Actual transparent alpha background.

Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: original transparent top-down pixel-art combat attachment reference for a portrait H5 space survivor game, to be hand-cleaned on a native 40x40 pixel grid.
Primary request: one compact mechanical thunder relay attachment for a bee-drone swarm, a gold-white conducting ring surrounding a small purple-grey hexagonal capacitor socket. Four distinct outward gold-white electrode forks at the top, bottom, left and right cardinal directions. Electrodes have two-tine metal contacts, brass bases and tiny ivory contact tips where runtime lightning can attach. The ring has a transparent gap around its central capacitor and readable hard metal blocks, with pale-violet insulators. This is a physical relay, no drone wings and no ship body. Keep the four contact endpoints extremely clear and symmetric. The center ring and electrode assembly must read as independently animatable parts.
Style/medium: deliberately crisp native-pixel sprite art, medium pixel detail and readable clusters, about 40x40 logical pixels enlarged with integer nearest-neighbor scaling. Strict stepped pixel edges and hard color clusters. Top-down orthographic.
Color palette: ink #17172b, purple-grey armor #393449 #57516d #756c8e, brass #825d42 #bd8a51, gold #f4c57a, cream #ffe5a6, white highlights, a little lavender #a483c4 #d1b5e3 on insulators.
Composition/framing: one whole attachment centered and isolated, complete silhouette, generous transparent outer margin. No text, no labels, no scene, no background, no bolts connecting external objects, no glow haze, no blur, no gradients, no smooth vector contours, no UI frame. Actual transparent alpha background.

Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: original transparent top-down pixel-art combat sprite reference for a portrait H5 space survivor game, to be hand-cleaned on a native 48x48 pixel grid.
Primary request: a six-sided mechanical blastwheel hub, a faceted gold-orange reactor at the center held inside a heavy hexagonal violet-grey metal housing, six equally spaced mechanical rail sockets around the outside to support independently orbiting saw blades at runtime. Build a deeply shaded segmented hexagonal ring, copper connections, pale ivory bolt heads, gold-orange core with one bright white-hot center pixel cluster. Broad readable hexagonal silhouette with bevel facets and tiny mechanical seams. Keep the reactor core visibly distinct from its surrounding dark housing. NO outer blades in this asset, only the complete six-socket hub and its reactor.

Composition/framing: one whole mechanical hub alone centered, generous transparent outer margin. No text, no labels, no scene, no background, no additional blades, no glow haze, no blur, no gradients, no smooth vector contours, no UI frame, no loose sparks. Actual transparent alpha background.
